remarks: For rent in Byington Place! This beautiful 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse offers modern comfort and convenience in a prime location. The main floor offers a beautifully updated kitchen, a convenient adjacent laundry area and half bath. The spacious living room, perfect for entertaining, features a cozy fireplace that adds warmth and charm. Upstairs, discover two generously sized bedrooms, including a luxurious Primary suite with a soaring vaulted ceiling, a private full bath and a large walk-in closet. A second full bathroom with a tub/shower combo completes the upper level. The lower level includes a 2-car garage and ample storage space, ideal for all your needs. Nestled next to Norwalk's scenic bike trail, this move-in-ready townhouse offers easy access to I-95, Route 7 and the Merritt Parkway, making commuting a breeze. Enjoy the perfect blend of modern updates, thoughtful design, and an unbeatable location in this vibrant community. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exquisite townhouse yours! Schedule a today and experience all that Byington Place has to offer.
